dialogue.grandline.board: Notices flutter in the sea wind: odd jobs, deliveries, escorts and wanted posters.
dialogue.grandline.board.empty: The board is bare. Come back later.
grandline.board.name: Notice Board of %s
job.grandline.camp.desc: Break up the bandit camp in the wilds of %1$s: defeat %2$s bandits.
job.grandline.deliver.desc: Carry a sealed letter to %1$s on %2$s.
job.grandline.escort.desc: The merchant %1$s sails ahead to %2$s. Pirates are said to wait at its dock: be there, clear them out and see %1$s safely ashore.
job.grandline.fish.desc: The taverns of %1$s want %2$s fish, any kind.
job.grandline.greet.merchant: Ah, my escort! I thought those pirates would have me for breakfast.
job.grandline.greet.outlaw: Another bounty hunter? %1$s doesn't go quietly.
job.grandline.hunt.desc: Dead or alive, %3$s Beli. Last seen on %2$s, near %4$s, %5$s.
job.grandline.hunt.desc.bounty_hunter: Bring %1$s in alive: %3$s Beli, and a bonus from the Marines' bounty office. Last seen on %2$s, near %4$s, %5$s.
job.grandline.hunt.desc.marine: Wanted by the Marines: %1$s, %3$s Beli. Last seen on %2$s, near %4$s, %5$s. Arrest them for the bounty and a commendation.
job.grandline.nest.desc: Slay %3$s %1$s from the nest out in the wilds of %2$s.
job.grandline.wreck.desc: The %1$s went down off %2$s with its cargo. Dive to the wreck and recover what you can.
story.grandline.bandit_toll.1.desc: %2$s, headman of %1$s, says bandits under %4$s squeeze the village for a "road toll". Hear out %3$s, who refused to pay.
story.grandline.bandit_toll.2.desc: %3$s's stall was burnt for refusing the toll. %4$s's gang camps out in the wilds of %1$s: break them up.
story.grandline.bandit_toll.3.desc: Bring down %4$s, then tell %2$s the roads of %1$s are free.
story.grandline.bandit_toll.3.desc.bount: %4$s has a price on their head: cuff them alive and tell %2$s.
story.grandline.bandit_toll.3.desc.marin: Arrest %4$s with seastone cuffs and report to %2$s.
story.grandline.bandit_toll.3.desc.pirat: Beat %4$s and help yourself to the toll money. %3$s will keep quiet for a share.
story.grandline.bandit_toll.greet.chief: Toll's a hundred Beli a head. Yours looks expensive.
story.grandline.bandit_toll.greet.headma: Welcome to %1$s, stranger. You look handy. We have... a toll problem.
story.grandline.bandit_toll.greet.victim: They burnt my stall because I wouldn't pay %4$s. Next time it's my house.
story.grandline.bandit_toll.rumor: They say %4$s's gang charges a toll on every road of %1$s, even the goat track.
story.grandline.bandit_toll.thanks.headm: The roads are free and the market's full again. %1$s won't forget you.
story.grandline.beast_nest.1.desc: %2$s found the tracks of a %3$s pack out in the wilds of %1$s. Find them.
story.grandline.beast_nest.2.desc: The tracks lead to a nest. Slay the %3$s that live there before they find the village.
story.grandline.beast_nest.greet.hunter: %3$s tracks, fresh, as big as my head. That nest needs clearing before winter.
story.grandline.beast_nest.thanks.hunter: Good meat on those. Take some.
story.grandline.castaway.1.desc: %2$s has lived alone on %1$s since a storm wrecked their ship years ago. They would give anything for %4$s.
story.grandline.castaway.2.desc: %2$s buried the ship's savings somewhere on %1$s and drew a map in the sand. Find the spot.
story.grandline.castaway.3.desc: Bring the savings to %2$s. Home is %3$s, a long way off.
story.grandline.castaway.greet.castaway: A person! A real person! Do you have %4$s? I've eaten nothing but coconuts for six years.
story.grandline.castaway.rumor: Somebody lives alone on %1$s, they say. Waves at every ship.
story.grandline.castaway.thanks.castaway: Take this Eternal Pose: it points to %3$s, my home. One day I'll follow it.
story.grandline.crooked_officer.1.desc: %2$s, a Marine of %1$s, says Captain %3$s sells protection and pockets the base's pay. The proof is in a strongbox hidden out in the wilds. Find it.
story.grandline.crooked_officer.2.desc: The ledger proves it. Bring down Captain %3$s and his bullies, then report to %2$s.
story.grandline.crooked_officer.2.desc.b: The Marines' own inspectors have put a quiet price on %3$s. Cuff him and report to %2$s.
story.grandline.crooked_officer.2.desc.m: The ledger proves it. Arrest Captain %3$s for the honour of the Marines and report to %2$s.
story.grandline.crooked_officer.2.desc.r: A rotten captain is exactly what the Revolution is for. Break %3$s and his men, then tell %2$s.
story.grandline.crooked_officer.greet.of: Justice is expensive on %1$s. Do you have the fee?
story.grandline.crooked_officer.greet.wh: Not here. ...The captain has ears everywhere. Meet me where he can't see us.
story.grandline.crooked_officer.rumor: The Marines of %1$s collect "protection" from the fishermen. Captain %3$s's idea, people whisper.
story.grandline.crooked_officer.thanks.w: The new captain is honest, as far as I can tell. Thank you. Truly.
story.grandline.cursed_shrine.1.desc: %2$s says the old shrine of %3$s on %1$s has woken: lights at night, stone guardians walking. Go and see.
story.grandline.cursed_shrine.2.desc: The guardians of the shrine attack anyone who comes near. Put them back to sleep, by force.
story.grandline.cursed_shrine.3.desc: Bring %4$s as an offering and talk to %2$s. The spirit of %3$s should rest again.
story.grandline.cursed_shrine.greet.prie: Do you hear it at night? The shrine of %3$s is humming again.
story.grandline.cursed_shrine.rumor: Lights at the old shrine of %3$s again. %2$s hasn't slept a wink.
story.grandline.cursed_shrine.thanks.pri: The shrine is quiet. %3$s sleeps, and so, at last, do I.
story.grandline.debt_collector.1.desc: %2$s owes money to %4$s, agent of the Warlord they call %5$s. So does half of %1$s, and the interest doubles every week. Talk to %3$s.
story.grandline.debt_collector.2.desc: %4$s collects with bodyguards (%6$s) at their back. Thin them out at the office outside town.
story.grandline.debt_collector.3.desc: Bring down %4$s and burn the ledger. Then tell %2$s.
story.grandline.debt_collector.3.desc.bo: %4$s's bounty is quiet but real. Cuff them and tell %2$s.
story.grandline.debt_collector.3.desc.ma: Arrest %4$s: even a Warlord's agent can be charged with extortion. Tell %2$s.
story.grandline.debt_collector.3.desc.pi: Take %4$s down and keep the ledger. %3$s will help you collect.
story.grandline.debt_collector.3.desc.re: Break %4$s and burn the ledger: the people of %1$s owe a Warlord nothing.
story.grandline.debt_collector.greet.age: The Warlord they call %5$s sends regards. And an invoice.
story.grandline.debt_collector.greet.deb: I borrowed ten thousand. I owe two hundred thousand. The Warlord they call %5$s is very good at arithmetic.
Shh. %4$s's people are listening. Always listening.
story.grandline.debt_collector.rumor: The Warlord they call %5$s owns half of %1$s on paper, and %4$s collects.
story.grandline.debt_collector.thanks.de: The ledger burned. Every page. I danced. Badly.
story.grandline.deserter.1.desc: %3$s deserted the Marine base of %1$s with the payroll. %2$s wants him found. Look for his camp in the wilds.
story.grandline.deserter.2.desc.pirate: %3$s offers you half the payroll to look the other way. Hear him out.
story.grandline.deserter.3.desc.pirate: Collect the payroll where %3$s hid it.
story.grandline.deserter.greet.commander: A Marine who runs is a Marine who talks. Find %3$s before someone else does.
story.grandline.deserter.greet.deserter: I didn't sign up to collect protection money. ...Are you here to take me back?
story.grandline.deserter.rumor: A Marine ran off with the payroll of %1$s. The base is turning the island upside down.
story.grandline.deserter.thanks.commande: Discipline restored. Paperwork filed. The two finest words in the Navy.
story.grandline.family_feud.1.desc: The %4$s and %5$s families have feuded for three generations over an orchard. %2$s asks you to speak to %3$s.
story.grandline.family_feud.2.desc: %3$s swears the %5$s family burnt nothing: someone hired bandits to torch the orchard and blame both houses. Drive them off.
story.grandline.family_feud.3.desc: Bring %6$s as a peace gift, and talk to %3$s and %2$s. Maybe this is the end of it.
story.grandline.family_feud.greet.head_a: The %5$s family will be the death of this island. Or I will be the death of them.
story.grandline.family_feud.greet.head_b: If %2$s sent you, you can tell them the orchard is ours.
story.grandline.family_feud.rumor: The %4$s and %5$s families of %1$s haven't spoken in thirty years. Somebody burnt the orchard again.
story.grandline.family_feud.thanks.head_: We shared a table with the %5$s family last night. My grandfather is spinning in his grave. It was lovely.
story.grandline.festival.1.desc: %2$s is preparing %4$s for %1$s and needs %5$s for the decorations.
story.grandline.festival.2.desc: Pirates under %3$s raid the square right before %4$s. Drive them off and defeat %3$s.
story.grandline.festival.2.desc.bounty_h: %3$s has a bounty: drive off the raiders and bring %3$s in alive.
story.grandline.festival.2.desc.marine: Pirates raid the square. Drive them off and arrest %3$s.
story.grandline.festival.3.desc: The square is safe. Tell %2$s that %4$s can begin.
story.grandline.festival.greet.organizer: %4$s is the best night of the year. If it happens. If anything else goes wrong I'll scream.
story.grandline.festival.greet.raider: Nice party. We'll take the cash box.
story.grandline.festival.rumor: %4$s is coming to %1$s! If %2$s doesn't faint from worry first.
story.grandline.festival.thanks.organize: Lanterns, music, dancing, and nobody stabbed! The best %4$s ever.
story.grandline.fever.1.desc: A fever is spreading through %1$s. %2$s needs a cure that only %3$s, a herbalist on %4$s, knows. Sail there.
story.grandline.fever.greet.doctor: Half the village is in bed and the other half is coughing. I need help I can't give myself.
story.grandline.fever.greet.herbalist: %2$s sent you? Then %1$s has the marsh fever again. I know the cure. You do the walking.
story.grandline.fever.rumor: The fever's back on %1$s. %2$s hasn't slept in days.
story.grandline.fever.thanks.doctor: The fever broke. Every patient. I could kiss you. I won't: you might be contagious.
story.grandline.heirloom.1.desc: %2$s's husband went down with the %4$s, and the family locket with him. %3$s, down at the dock, was the only survivor.
story.grandline.heirloom.2.desc: %3$s remembers where the %4$s sank off the coast of %1$s. Dive to the wreck and find the locket.
story.grandline.heirloom.3.desc: You found the locket in the wreck of the %4$s. Bring it to %2$s.
story.grandline.heirloom.greet.old_salt: The %4$s? Aye. I was there. I still hear the timbers.
story.grandline.heirloom.greet.widow: Forty years since the %4$s sank. I still keep a candle in the window.
story.grandline.heirloom.rumor: Old %3$s still talks about the night the %4$s went down off %1$s.
story.grandline.heirloom.thanks.widow: His locket. He wore it every day. ...Thank you, dear.
story.grandline.lost_child.1.desc: %4$s, child of %2$s, has not come home. Their friend %3$s knows more than they've said.
story.grandline.lost_child.2.desc: %3$s admits they dared %4$s to spend a night in the hollow out in the wilds. Find the hollow, deal with whatever prowls there and bring %4$s home.
story.grandline.lost_child.3.desc: %4$s is on the way home. Tell %2$s.
story.grandline.lost_child.greet.child: I'm not scared! ...Is it gone? Can we go home now?
story.grandline.lost_child.greet.friend: It wasn't my fault! ...Okay, it was a little bit my fault.
story.grandline.lost_child.greet.parent: Have you seen my child? %4$s didn't come home last night...
story.grandline.lost_child.rumor: %2$s's little one went missing in the wilds of %1$s. The whole village is out looking.
story.grandline.lost_child.thanks.parent: You brought my %4$s back. Whatever we have is yours.
story.grandline.occupation.1.desc: The %4$s Pirates rule %1$s. %2$s gathers the townsfolk who want them gone. Start with their guard post.
story.grandline.occupation.2.desc: Bring down %3$s and the island is free.
story.grandline.occupation.2.desc.bounty: %3$s is worth a fortune. Cuff them.
story.grandline.occupation.2.desc.marine: Arrest %3$s: %1$s returns to the World Government's protection.
story.grandline.occupation.2.desc.revolu: Free %1$s: defeat %3$s and leave the people to rule themselves.
story.grandline.occupation.3.desc: Tell %2$s the black flag is down.
story.grandline.occupation.greet.leader: Keep your voice down. The %4$s Pirates hang people for talking.
story.grandline.occupation.greet.occupie: Welcome to my island. Everything here is mine. Including you, now.
story.grandline.occupation.rumor: The %4$s Pirates took %1$s. %3$s calls themself king.
story.grandline.occupation.thanks.leader: We've raised our own flag. It's not very good. It's ours.
story.grandline.rebel_cell.1.desc: %2$s leads a Revolutionary cell on %1$s. Their courier, %3$s, has news.
story.grandline.rebel_cell.2.desc: A Cipher Pol agent, %4$s, is closing in on the cell. Stop them first.
story.grandline.rebel_cell.3.desc: Tell %2$s the agent is dealt with.
story.grandline.rebel_cell.greet.cell_le: We don't exist. You never met me. ...Now that's settled: can you fight?
story.grandline.rebel_cell.greet.courier: Someone in a white suit asked about %2$s. Very polite smile.
story.grandline.rebel_cell.greet.cp_hunt: Government business. Move along, or join the people I'm looking for.
story.grandline.rebel_cell.rumor: A stranger in a white suit asks questions all over %1$s. Nobody answers.
story.grandline.rebel_cell.thanks.cell_l: The cell lives. When the dawn comes, %1$s will remember who helped.
story.grandline.rival_crew.1.desc: A rookie crew, the %4$s Pirates, camps on %1$s and picks fights with everyone. %2$s wants them humbled. Start with the crew.
story.grandline.rival_crew.2.desc: Their captain, %3$s, wants a duel. Give them one.
story.grandline.rival_crew.2.desc.bounty: %3$s's first bounty poster is still wet. Cuff them.
story.grandline.rival_crew.2.desc.marine: Defeat %3$s and arrest them before they become a real menace.
story.grandline.rival_crew.3.desc: %3$s was beaten fair and square. Talk to them.
story.grandline.rival_crew.3.desc.bounty: %3$s is on the way to the Marines. Tell %2$s.
story.grandline.rival_crew.3.desc.marine: %3$s is on the way to a Marine cell. Tell %2$s.
story.grandline.rival_crew.greet.barkeep: Those %4$s brats drink and don't pay. I'd pay to see them humbled.
story.grandline.rival_crew.greet.deckhan: Washed up here? Me too. Careful: the %4$s Pirates think this rock is theirs.
story.grandline.rival_crew.greet.rival: You! You've got the look of somebody worth beating. Draw!
story.grandline.rival_crew.rumor: There's a rookie crew on %1$s, the %4$s Pirates. Their captain wants to fight everyone.
story.grandline.rival_crew.thanks.barkee: First round's on the house. Second round's on the house. Third, you pay.
story.grandline.rival_crew.thanks.deckha: Funny, the island feels bigger now.
story.grandline.ruin_scholar.1.desc: %2$s studies the ancient ruin of %1$s: strange stones with writing nobody can read. Go and look.
story.grandline.ruin_scholar.2.desc: Guardians walk the ruin. Get past them and read the stone.
story.grandline.ruin_scholar.3.desc: Tell %2$s what the stone said. Carefully: the World Government hangs people for less.
story.grandline.ruin_scholar.greet.schol: Ruins older than the World Government. Writing nobody is allowed to read. I find that... suspicious.
story.grandline.ruin_scholar.rumor: %2$s spends every day out at the ruins of %1$s. Strange folk, scholars.
story.grandline.ruin_scholar.thanks.scho: So it's true. History has a hole in it, and that stone is the edge of it.
story.grandline.sea_beast.1.desc: %2$s's boats come back with shredded nets, when they come back at all. %3$s saw what did it. Ask them.
story.grandline.sea_beast.2.desc: %3$s swears it was a %4$s the size of a house. They call it %5$s. Find the torn nets on the shore of %1$s.
story.grandline.sea_beast.3.desc: Slay %5$s, the %4$s that hunts the waters of %1$s, then tell %2$s the boats can go out again.
story.grandline.sea_beast.greet.fisher: Three boats lost this month. Nobody fishes past the reef any more. If you're brave, or daft, I've work.
story.grandline.sea_beast.greet.witness: I saw it! %5$s! Eyes like lanterns! ...Nobody believes me.
story.grandline.sea_beast.rumor: The fishermen of %1$s won't sail past the reef any more. Something they call %5$s.
story.grandline.sea_beast.thanks.fisher: Full nets! You'll never pay for fish on %1$s again.
story.grandline.smugglers.1.desc: %2$s, harbourmaster of %1$s, keeps finding crates nobody declared. %3$s at the tavern hears everything, for a price.
story.grandline.smugglers.2.desc: %3$s says %4$s's smugglers keep their goods in a cache out of town. Find it and deal with its guards.
story.grandline.smugglers.3.desc: Bring down %4$s and tell %2$s the harbour is clean.
story.grandline.smugglers.3.desc.bounty_: %4$s is wanted in three seas. Cuff them and tell %2$s.
story.grandline.smugglers.3.desc.marine: Arrest %4$s and hand the evidence to %2$s.
story.grandline.smugglers.3.desc.pirate: Beat %4$s and let %3$s fence the goods for you. The harbourmaster need never know.
story.grandline.smugglers.greet.harbourm: Every crate on my dock has a stamp. Except the ones that don't. Those worry me.
story.grandline.smugglers.greet.informan: I hear things. Things cost money. You look like money.
story.grandline.smugglers.greet.smuggler: You didn't see any crates. There are no crates.
story.grandline.smugglers.rumor: Lights on the beach of %1$s at night. Boats without flags. Ask no questions.
story.grandline.smugglers.thanks.harbour: Clean books, clean docks. A harbourmaster's dream.
story.grandline.treasure_map.1.desc: %2$s has a map drawn by %3$s, a captain dead these thirty years. The X is on %1$s, and rival treasure hunters are already digging.
story.grandline.treasure_map.2.desc.pira: Bring %2$s their share. Or a smaller one: it's a pirate's map, after all.
story.grandline.treasure_map.greet.old_p: I sailed with %3$s. Mean as a shark, but they could draw a map.
story.grandline.treasure_map.rumor: There's gold buried on %1$s, they say. %3$s's gold.
story.grandline.treasure_map.thanks.old_: Ha! The old shark's gold, at last. Drink with me.
story.grandline.whodunit.1.desc: Somebody %7$s. %2$s has three suspects: %3$s, %4$s and %5$s. Question them all.
story.grandline.whodunit.2.desc: It was %6$s. Bring them to justice and tell %2$s.
story.grandline.whodunit.2.desc.bounty_h: It was %6$s. Cuff them and tell %2$s.
story.grandline.whodunit.2.desc.marine: It was %6$s. Arrest them and tell %2$s.
story.grandline.whodunit.crime.4: sold the village boats to pirates
story.grandline.whodunit.greet.guard: Somebody %7$s, and I have three suspects and no proof. Fancy playing detective?
story.grandline.whodunit.greet.suspect_1: Me? I was home all night. Ask anybody.
story.grandline.whodunit.greet.suspect_2: I know nothing. I saw nothing. I was asleep. Probably.
story.grandline.whodunit.greet.suspect_3: You think I'd do that? I've lived on %1$s all my life!
story.grandline.whodunit.rumor: Somebody %7$s, on %1$s of all places. %2$s is asking everyone.
story.grandline.whodunit.thanks.guard: %6$s confessed everything. You've a nose for this.
